alt: AI-generated Just Eat menu photo showing a fried egg and two sausages floating inside a tall glass of dark cola with ice, with bread visible on a plate in the background
story: On Oct 21–23, 2026, Just Eat apologized and paused a trial of AI-generated menu photos after they went viral: the AI placed fried eggs and sausages inside a cola glass (apparently reading 'soda bread' as soda), produced garlic bread shaped like a plane, and a jacket potato rendered as a puffer jacket — every image was manually reviewed by a human before going live.
why_funny: Just Eat deployed AI to make menus look more appetising, had a human check every image, and still managed to publish a photo of a Northern Irish breakfast floating in a pint of fizzy drink as the recommended image for a soda bread sandwich.
